Belgium stages World Cup comeback win against Senegal

Belgium achieved a dramatic 3-2 victory over Senegal in a World Cup match, coming from behind after trailing 0-2 until the 86th minute. Striker Romelu Lukaku played a role in diffusing an on-field disagreement between teammates before contributing to the team's revival. The win marked a significant comeback in the tournament.
